brief_rationale: The doctor systematically stratified psychiatric safety, managed antipsychotic medication risks, addressed cardiac red flags, grounded records in workspace data, provided low-stimulation home guidance, and achieved a bounded closure with family receipt—all without any serious or minor responsibility-chain error. Multiple high-order points (HO2, HO3, HO4) were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact, and closure was safe, executable, traceable, and valid. No important non-chain defect is present. This earns a 5 (Perfect).
